survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note compiles system-level and adult-skills indicators from Education at a Glance 2025 and related OECD data tables, rather than estimating a student-level model in the note itself. The note does not describe an analytic subsample selection or the use of complex survey weights (e.g., student sampling weights or replicate weights) for any ML or regression analysis. For indicators derived from PIAAC, the underlying OECD data products typically use survey design features and appropriate weighting when producing population-representative estimates, but this country note does not specify the weight variable names. Readers should consult the Education at a Glance 2025 “Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes” for indicator-specific sampling/weighting procedures; the present note is descriptive and does not provide a replicable weighting specification.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: The document is a descriptive OECD country note summarising education-system characteristics and adult-skills results; it does not report an analysis that requires plausible values (PVs) for cognitive achievement as a dependent variable. PV handling is therefore not applicable to the note’s presentation of indicator values. Missing-data handling is not reported because the note does not provide an original micro-data analysis pipeline (e.g., no model estimation with an explicit missing-data strategy) and instead points readers to the underlying OECD indicator tables and technical notes.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: The note provides Latvia-specific indicator values from Education at a Glance 2025 and does not define an analytic student-level subsample. It therefore does not specify inclusion/exclusion criteria for an original micro-data analysis; instead, it references OECD indicator tables (including PIAAC-based adult skills) and directs readers to the corresponding methodological technical notes.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note for Latvia synthesises education-system characteristics and labour-market/skills outcomes using published OECD indicator tables. It highlights differences in employment and earnings by educational attainment for adults aged 25–34, reports gender pay gaps among tertiary-educated adults, and summarises Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC) results for literacy and problem solving (e.g., shares at Level 1 or below and the proportion reaching the highest literacy levels). The note also describes policy and system features such as a reform allowing students who fail a centralised 9th-grade exam to enter vocational education and training, and a planned school funding model (“Programme in School”). Because the note is descriptive and does not present an original student-level modelling/ML pipeline, it does not report model performance metrics, PV handling, or missing-data procedures within the note itself. For methodological details behind each indicator, it directs readers to the Education at a Glance 2025 sources/methodologies and technical notes.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This extraction corresponds to a descriptive OECD country note rather than an empirical ML paper with an explicit modelling design, analytic sample, and predictive targets. As a result, fields such as total_students, per-country student counts, PV handling for a modelled achievement outcome, missing-data handling, and ML techniques are not provided in the note. The document instead reports indicator values and policy-relevant highlights, with methodological provenance deferred to the referenced Education at a Glance 2025 technical documentation.
